fix-w456: AstNodeWrapper::from_mut returns a wrapper whose wrapped is an accessor onto the caller's node: reads give the same object, stores (w.wrapped = n, or *w = x written Object.assign(w, x) / replace_in_place(w, x)) replace the caller's node in place via src/std/mut_ref.ts replace_in_place.
